title: I Upgraded Knights to BEAT Stockfish
summary: Tony's knights become 'Zebras' that leap in L-shapes of length two AND three (knight + camel, i.e. (2,1) and (3,1) leaps — not the classical (3,2) fairy zebra) vs Fairy-Stockfish. Zebras can develop to f4 on move 1. He plays a normal game, falls behind, and is mated by an under-promotion to bishop (~9:28): a loss.
rules: Player's knights replaced by Zebras: leap (2,1) like a knight OR (3,1) like a camel (both jump over pieces).

custom_pieces.name: Zebra (knight+camel)
custom_pieces.look: white knight with black zebra stripes

current_impl_issues: Impl generic 'fairy' upN — ensure the zebra here is knight+camel ((2,1)+(3,1)), not the standard (3,2) zebra.
